newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Morocco's industry prices index up 0.9 pct in Q4.
newsitem.headline: Morocco's industry prices index up 0.9 pct in Q4.

text.p: Morocco's industry, energy and mine output prices index rose 0.9 percent to 365.1 points in the fourth quarter of 1996, the Statistics Directorate said.
In its monthly newsletter received on Tuesday, the directorate said the index was at 361.8 points in the third quarter of 1996.
"The slight variation was due to a surge of energy prices, mainly refined fuel oil and by-products by 11.3 percent comapred with the previous quarter," the directorate said.
It said the average annual rise of production prices was 3.0 percent in 1996 over the previous year or the same as the inflation rate, the directorate added.
